actions.summary: One-year pilot putting Canva, Gemini for Education and NotebookLM in front of students at roughly a dozen schools, with all staff given access district-wide. Gemini and NotebookLM ride the district's existing Google Workspace license; Superintendent Jhone Ebert framed it as a measured, safety-first approach to emerging tech.
actions.notes: Fifth-largest district in the country and the only notable AI action found in Nevada. Explicitly a one-year pilot for 2025-26; whether it continued or expanded into 2026-27 is unconfirmed as of 2026-09-14, so effective_until is set to the end of that pilot year and the row reads as expired. Nevada also has state-level DOE guidance. Enrollment approximate. Student access was limited to roughly a dozen pilot schools; staff access was district-wide.
